# prime-skeleton

prime-rs: Skeleton component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/skeleton) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-skeleton) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/skeleton.md)

Skeleton — port of `p-skeleton` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Loading placeholder: `div.p-skeleton.p-component[aria-hidden=true]` (instead of the `<p-skeleton>` host); shape, size and rounding are set
by properties and end up in the inline style, as in PrimeNG.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_skeleton::{Skeleton, SkeletonShape};

let html = view! { <Skeleton shape=SkeletonShape::Circle size="4rem" /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-skeleton-circle") && html.contains("width: 4rem; height: 4rem;"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-skeleton = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["skeleton"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
